test_python_tokenizer: test the python tokenizer with standard code examples including assignments, imports, and control flow
test_python_tokenizer_with_coms: test the python tokenizer with comments enabled to preserve inline and block comments in output
test_python_detokenizer: test the python detokenizer by round-tripping code through tokenize and detokenize
create_tokenize_python: create a function to tokenize Python source code into a list of tokens with special markers
create_detokenize_python: create a function to detokenize a list of tokens back into valid Python source code
